Validation: local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 IPv6-off PASS 15/15 (app_identity 6, app_identity_store 9); qemu_x86 IPv6-on PASS 15/15; both production Settings adapter/core compiled under GCC 12 strict project warnings; git diff --check passed. cppcheck reached both files but reports the repository Monocypher header's known false syntaxError on MONOCYPHER_CPP_NAMESPACE; compiler gates are clean."}
